description: The Rage of Mugamba Level 60 King Rastakhan sends his regards, Master <name>. Such an honor has never been given to one outside the Zandalar tribe. Give me your talisman so that I may enhance it once more. Know that the Rage of Mugamba is now intrinsically connected to your very soul. Requirements: - Strength of Mugamba
name: The Rage of Mugamba
